LESSON: IMITATIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.9: Imitative Speaking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Imitative Speaking, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 5 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why do we take meals? 2. How does vocabulary help in the language learning?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a recording on meals from a digital device and answer the questions in groups,

2. work jointly to identify names of various foods and drinks from pictures,

3. make a vocabulary bank of vocabulary related to foods and drinks,

4. work collaboratively to categorize the different meals into the various times they could be taken (e.g. for breakfast, lunch, dinner/supper)

5. use the acquired vocabulary to make sentences using correct pronunciation,

6. conduct a conversation in pairs using vocabularies related to different mealtimes. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a recording on meals from a digital device and answer the questions in groups,
2. work jointly to identify names of various foods and drinks from pictures,
3. make a vocabulary bank of vocabulary related to foods and drinks,
4. work collaboratively to categorize the different meals into the various times they could be taken (e.g. for breakfast, lunch, dinner/supper)
5. use the acquired vocabulary to make sentences using correct pronunciation,
6. conduct a conversation in pairs using vocabularies related to different mealtimes. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Imitative Speaking together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: This is promoted as the learner interacts with digital content when listening to a recording on meals from a

digital device and answers the questions in groups

• Self-efficacy: This is promoted as the learner exhibits organization skills when categorizing the different meals into the

various times they could be taken.

Values:
Unity: This is promoted as the learner displays a team spirit while working jointly to identify names of various foods and drinks

from pictures.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Food security: This is promoted as the learners interact with information on various foods in their environment and times when

the meals are preferably taken.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept on foods and drinks to their learning of similar concepts in Agriculture.
